system.description:
You can tap into the leylines of the natural world with a Spellcasting Roll (15). On a success, you may mark 3 Stress to affect an event within the immediate future of this location. Until the next rest, you and all allies benefit from these effects:

  • Gain Advantage on all Reaction Rolls
  • When an ally rolls a Failure with Hope, you may mark a Stress to change it to a Success with Hope.
